statement:
∀ (p : Polynomial ℂ) (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ),
  ContDiff ℝ 1 γ → γ a = γ b → cint cexp γ a b = 0 ∧ cint cos γ a b = 0 ∧ cint (fun z => Polynomial.eval z p) γ a b = 0

goal.text: cint cexp γ a b = 0 ∧ cint cos γ a b = 0 ∧ cint (fun z => Polynomial.eval z p) γ a b = 0

values: (fun s : ℝ => 2 * Real.cos s + Complex.I * Real.sin s)
